content: 我司今年的营收是多少
SELECT total_operating_revenue FROM income_sheet WHERE stock_abbr = '金花股份' AND report_period LIKE '2024%' ORDER BY report_period DESC LIMIT 1;
我司近三年的利润增长是多少

SELECT report_period, net_profit_yoy_growth 
FROM income_sheet 
WHERE stock_abbr = 'YOUR_COMPANY_ABBR' 
ORDER BY report_period DESC 
LIMIT 3;
我司今年第三季度亏损多少

SELECT stock_abbr, report_period, net_profit
FROM income_sheet
WHERE stock_abbr = '目标公司'
  AND report_period LIKE '2024-09%'
ORDER BY report_period DESC
LIMIT 1;
